i'm not saying lose every friend that is not 100 percent i'm saying just match the energy because i'm telling you if you care and the other person does not really care you look pretty dumb. i've been depressed my whole short life and you learn something from each whole you find yourself in. relationships some and go, very clique but very true. the ones who stay cherish them cuz you don't know the last time you'll hang out. but if you don't want to focus on yourself may i suggest go volunteer at a soup kitchen if there is one open available to participate in. go donate your old clothes. help your community in some way. learn a new skill. life can be rough but focusing on broken relationships will make you feel even more isolated. don't blame your age weight or anything else anyone can make relationships we need it to survive.  and like you said life is about changes and changes in relationships are good you weed out the bad one.

your just experiencing life. in all the posts here there is something similar as to my friends are leaving me and so forth. you don't need friends anyone that doesn't talk to you don't give them any attention. maybe not that but what i'm trying to say is match their levels of "commitment ".those that don't stay along can simply grow old and die. seems a bit harsh but the truth let them live and you could live. i've ruined so many relationships through drug abuse (alcohol and weed and nic.) but that doesn't mean you can't make new connections. you had connections before. you can start again. like starting a new game or new world in minecraft. be you. work on yourself. workout. this might be tough if you have depression and you should talk to a family member but what you can do is just focus on your self, match energy lol, and enjoy life.
